decimate_qem — 3D mesh_process op

• Data kinds: mesh → mesh

• Call: import meshrepair; meshrepair.decimate_qem(V, F, target_faces, protect=None) (or ops3d.get("decimate_qem"))

Usage

Quadric-error-metric edge-collapse decimation toward *target_faces*.
